reason: independent (opaque fixpoint): Without the hypothesis the collectors (toList/toArray/toListRev: WellFounded.extrinsicFix₂ with relation InvImage Finite.Rel finitelyManySteps!) and the default IteratorLoop (extrinsicFix₃ with IteratorLoop.rel) of a non-Finite iterator type are the opaque WellFounded.opaqueFix (no equations in the kernel). Family collector-of-combinator: the combinator iterator (map/filter/filterMap/mapWithPostcondition/mapM/filterMapM/attachWith/uLift; split = splitToSubslice.map toSlice) over a non-Finite base is not Finite either (its plausible steps mirror the base's: over YL it yields forever), so the left side is opaqueFix at the combinator's collect loop and the right side a list/array/monadic function of the base iterator's collect loop, another opaqueFix argument (different iterator type and loop functional); nothing relates the two values. Interpreting opaqueFix at the combinator's arguments by the right side's formula applied to the base value (recursively over nested combinators) makes T' true, as in the Finite case; changing it at one argument (e.g. over YL) makes T' false. Lean support: OpEHand.Iter.toArray_mapM.h10_neg derives ¬T' from an assignment of values to the opaque terms (checks/OpEHand.lean).
